title: 4-by-4 register file

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54170, SN54LS170, SN74170, SN74LS170 4-by-4 register files with open-collector outputs, bulletin DL-S 7611349 (revised October 1976)

pins.name: GW
pins.text: write enable: while low, the addressed word's latches follow D1-D4 (level, not edge)

pins.name: GR
pins.text: read enable; high: outputs off (open collector, pulled high)

functions.formula: Q1 = NOT(GR') OR ((RB'RA' AND W0B1) OR (RB'RA AND W1B1) OR (RBRA' AND W2B1) OR (RBRA AND W3B1))
functions.text: With GR low, Q1 shows bit 1 of the word picked by RB,RA (true data, non-destructive read); with GR high the output is off (high with a pull-up).

functions.formula: Q2 = NOT(GR') OR ((RB'RA' AND W0B2) OR (RB'RA AND W1B2) OR (RBRA' AND W2B2) OR (RBRA AND W3B2))
functions.text: With GR low, Q2 shows bit 2 of the word picked by RB,RA (true data, non-destructive read); with GR high the output is off (high with a pull-up).

functions.formula: Q3 = NOT(GR') OR ((RB'RA' AND W0B3) OR (RB'RA AND W1B3) OR (RBRA' AND W2B3) OR (RBRA AND W3B3))
functions.text: With GR low, Q3 shows bit 3 of the word picked by RB,RA (true data, non-destructive read); with GR high the output is off (high with a pull-up).

functions.formula: Q4 = NOT(GR') OR ((RB'RA' AND W0B4) OR (RB'RA AND W1B4) OR (RBRA' AND W2B4) OR (RBRA AND W3B4))
functions.text: With GR low, Q4 shows bit 4 of the word picked by RB,RA (true data, non-destructive read); with GR high the output is off (high with a pull-up).

rules: GW low, WB,WA = 0: word 0 latches = D1..D4 (follow the data inputs); other words hold
GW low, WB,WA = 1: word 1 = D; GW low, WB,WA = 2: word 2 = D; GW low, WB,WA = 3: word 3 = D
GW high: all words hold; data inputs inhibited
Writing and reading may happen at the same time at different addresses; a read of a word just written needs the latch time tlatch (25 ns) after the write

electrical.notes: Open-collector outputs: recommended VOH max 5.5 V; IOH (off-state) 30 uA max at VOH 5.5 V. Up to 256 outputs may be wire-AND connected.
